rules.reason: "HPE DL145 Gen11 Desk/Wall Mount Kit" and "HPE DL145 Gen11 Rack enable kit" cannot be selected together.
All DIMMs selected in a server configuration must be of the same part number, capacity size, rank etc.
BTO Memories are not allowed in CTO Base Model.
If HPE DL145 Gen11 Opt ACC FIO Config is selected, then these EDSFF drives cannot be selected with direct attach. (Only controller mode).
CE Mark label SKU (P35876-B21) should be visible only when selecting Lot9 SKU's in the configuration
Max quantity of product limited by space available.
Mixing of Power Supplies is not allowed.
If AC Power Supply is selected then only AC Power Cords should be in the drop-down.
BTO products are not allowed in CTO Base Model.
